description: This file defines the ClientService interface, which declares methods for managing Client entities, including retrieval, saving, and deletion operations, as well as fetching client statuses and clients associated with a specific user.

classes.name: ClientService
classes.description: Interface for client management operations, including finding clients by ID or name, retrieving all clients, managing client statuses, saving and deleting clients, and finding clients associated with a user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object by its unique identifier.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object by the company's name.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Client objects.

methods.name: getStatusList
methods.description: Provides a list of possible client statuses as strings.

methods.name: saveClient
methods.description: Saves a Client object and returns its assigned ID.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a client identified by its ID.

methods.name: saveClientWithLoggedUser
methods.description: Saves a Client with the currently logged-in user as the managing employee, returning the client's ID.

methods.name: findByUser
methods.description: Finds a list of clients managed by a specific user.
